profile.headline: Software Engineer | ML Systems, Applied AI & Cloud Infrastructure
profile.summary:
I'm a senior software engineer with a background in electrical engineering and experience spanning healthcare software, cloud infrastructure, and production AI/ML systems.

I started my career developing software for healthcare coding, reimbursement, and claim estimation. That work built my foundation in SQL, data processing, automation, and translating complex business requirements into reliable software.

At Solventum, I build and operate AWS infrastructure for seven production ML services spanning NLP, code prediction, confidence scoring, and LLM-assisted inference. I’ve built reusable deployment and observability capabilities, led the GovCloud rollout of an existing ML training platform and two research applications, and corrected GPU provisioning that reduced monthly GPU compute spend by approximately 70%.

My work also included preparing an agentic medical-coding application for enterprise deployment through authentication, connectivity, and hosting contributions. Alongside model and application teams, I've diagnosed inference failures, Bedrock/LangChain integration issues, and failures in processing generated model outputs. I’ve complemented this professional experience with hands-on coursework in agent orchestration, tool use, memory, retrieval-augmented generation, MCP integration, evaluation, and observability.

I'm particularly interested in designing and building applied AI and agentic systems, combining experimentation with the engineering needed to turn promising ideas into useful applications. Research engineering, model behavior, and software architecture are especially compelling to me. I value opportunities to investigate unfamiliar problems, make thoughtful design decisions, and take technical ownership while remaining closely involved in implementation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
NLU Architecture / ML Platform

Promoted to Senior Software Engineer after independently delivering reusable ML platform capabilities and production-readiness improvements across multiple services.

• Own production patterns for ML/NLU services across deployment automation, model serving, observability, security, and cloud infrastructure.

• Design reusable platform capabilities that reduce service-specific implementation work and improve consistency across ML workloads.

• Partner with ML teams to translate models and service configurations into reliable, maintainable production systems.

• Diagnose complex failures spanning application configuration, containers, AWS infrastructure, networking, CI/CD, and model-serving runtimes.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Python (Programming Language) and +9 skills

positions.title: Advanced Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
NLU Architecture / ML Platform

Built reusable infrastructure and production-readiness capabilities for ML inference services supporting NLP workloads in regulated AWS environments.

• Developed a configurable Terraform and AWS Lambda capability that integrates CloudWatch metrics into centralized Kibana observability workflows across multiple services.

• Standardized TorchServe observability through normalized runtime and inference metrics, Filebeat processing, and reusable Kibana dashboards.

• Built parameterized GitHub Actions smoke-testing workflows for multiple inference paths and request configurations, reducing the need for service-specific test implementations.

• Productionized and supported multiple ML inference services across ECS Fargate, containers, load balancing, IAM, networking, CI/CD, security remediation, application configuration, and model-serving behavior.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Python (Programming Language) and +9 skills

positions.title: Advanced Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
TopData / Pricer Tables

Built data-focused software supporting healthcare coding, reimbursement, and claim-estimation products.

• Implemented MySQL stored procedures, schema changes, and data-transformation logic based on healthcare business and calculation requirements.

• Developed F# and batch scripts to import and process data from Excel, PDF, and other external source formats.

• Validated pricing and reimbursement datasets, investigated data-quality issues, and corrected discrepancies before production delivery.

• Collaborated with requirements analysts and engineers to convert healthcare reimbursement rules into reliable, repeatable software workflows.
